toolCalls.args: {"command":"Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Mode, LastWriteTime, Length, Name | Format-Table -AutoSize"}

{"command":"Get-Command git.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Source; Test-Path \"$env:ProgramFiles\\Git\\cmd\\git.exe\"; Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\.git -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 5 Name"}

{"command":"Get-Content .\\workspace\\.git\\HEAD; Write-Output '---REBASE_HEAD---'; Get-Content .\\workspace\\.git\\REBASE_HEAD; Write-Output '---ORIG_HEAD---'; Get-Content .\\workspace\\.git\\ORIG_HEAD; Write-Output '---config---'; Get-Content .\\workspace\\.git\\config"}

{"command":"Get-Content .\\workspace\\.git\\FETCH_HEAD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 10; Write-Output '---refs---'; Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\.git\\refs -Recurse -Force | Select-Object FullName"}

{"command":"$i=0; Get-Content .\\input\\session.jsonl | ForEach-Object { $o = $_ | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $o.payload; $t = $p.type; $extra=''; if($t -eq 'response_item'){ $extra = $p.payload.type; if($p.payload.type -eq 'message'){ $extra += ' role=' + $p.payload.role } }; if($t -eq 'event_msg'){ $extra = $p.type }; $i++; \"{0}`t{1}`t{2}`t{3}\" -f $i,$o.timestamp,$t,$extra }"}

{"command":"Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\web\\src\\components -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Length; Write-Output '---web/src---'; Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\web\\src -Recurse -File | Select-Object FullName | Format-Table -AutoSize"}

{"command":"Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\.worktrees -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 10 FullName; Write-Output '--counts--'; foreach($d in @('.worktrees','handoff-output','out','out2','out-electron','out-electron-final','out-electron-release','out-electron-v2')){ $p = Join-Path (Resolve-Path .\\workspace) $d; if(Test-Path $p){ $c = (Get-ChildItem $p -Recurse -Force -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count; $sz = (Get-ChildItem $p -Recurse -Force -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum; '{0}: files={1} bytes={2}' -f $d,$c,$sz } else { '{0}: MISSING' -f $d } }"}

{"command":"Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\web -Force | Select-Object Mode,Name | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output '--scripts--'; Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\scripts -File | Select-Object Name | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output '--electron--'; Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\electron -Recurse -File | Select-Object FullName | Format-Table -AutoSize"}

{"command":"Get-Content .\\workspace\\.git\\refs\\heads\\main; Write-Output '---log---'; Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\.git\\logs -Recurse -Force | Select-Object FullName | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output '---index timestamp---'; (Get-Item .\\workspace\\.git\\index).LastWriteTime"}

{"command":"Get-ChildItem .\\workspace -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('.runtime','node_modules','.worktrees','handoff-output','out','out2','out-electron','out-electron-final','out-electron-release','out-electron-v2') } | Select-Object Name; Write-Output '---jsx remnants---'; Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\web\\src -Recurse -Filter *.jsx | Select-Object FullName; Write-Output '---component jsx---'; (Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\web\\src\\components -Filter *.jsx | Measure-Object).Count"}

{"command":"Get-Content .\\workspace\\web\\src\\App.js -TotalCount 3; Write-Output '---'; Get-Content .\\workspace\\web\\src\\components\\ConversationPanel.js -TotalCount 2; Write-Output '---margin html title done---'; Get-Content .\\workspace\\electron\\main.js -TotalCount 15"}
